name: ReceiptBatch_getCreditCards
command:
-- Read-only mirror of the EBS CreditCardsVO card LOV for the receipt card dropdown.
-- No DML. The first branch computes the oldest available posted date with an exact,
-- context-independent port of AP_WEB_DB_CCARD_PKG.GetOldestAvailPostedDate: it
-- queries ap_credit_card_trxns_all directly, org-scoped through params, instead of
-- relying on the package's MO-scoped ap_credit_card_trxns session context.
WITH params AS (
    SELECT TO_NUMBER(CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM('${ORG_ID}'), '^[0-9]+$')
               THEN TRIM('${ORG_ID}')
           END) AS org_id,
           TO_NUMBER(CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM('${REPORT_HEADER_ID}'), '^[0-9]+$')
               THEN TRIM('${REPORT_HEADER_ID}')
           END) AS report_header_id,
           TO_NUMBER(CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM('${SECURITY_GROUP_ID}'), '^[0-9]+$')
               THEN TRIM('${SECURITY_GROUP_ID}')
               ELSE '0'
           END) AS security_group_id,
           NVL(NULLIF(TRIM('${LANGUAGE_CODE}'), ''), 'US') AS language_code,
           NVL(NULLIF(TRIM('${REIMBURSEMENT_CURRENCY}'), ''), 'USD') AS reimb_currency
    FROM   dual
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(card_id) AS "CARD_ID",
       card_program_name || ' ' || card_number AS "CreditCardList",
       card_program_id AS "CARD_PROGRAM_ID",
       payment_due_from_code AS "PAYMENT_DUE_FROM_CODE"
FROM   (
    SELECT eligible_card.card_program_id,
           eligible_card.card_program_name,
           eligible_card.card_number,
           eligible_card.card_id,
           eligible_card.displayed_value,
           eligible_card.payment_due_from_code,
           eligible_card.payment_due_from,
           NVL((SELECT MIN(cct.posted_date)
                FROM   ap_credit_card_trxns_all cct
                WHERE  cct.org_id = (SELECT org_id FROM params)
                AND    cct.card_program_id = eligible_card.card_program_id
                AND    cct.card_id = eligible_card.card_id
                AND    cct.payment_due_from_code = eligible_card.payment_due_from_code
                AND    cct.billed_currency_code = (SELECT reimb_currency FROM params)
                AND    cct.validate_code = 'Y'
                AND    cct.payment_flag <> 'Y'
                AND    NVL(cct.category, 'BUSINESS') NOT IN ('DISPUTED','CREDIT','MATCHED','DEACTIVATED')
                AND    (cct.report_header_id IS NULL OR cct.report_header_id = (SELECT report_header_id FROM params))
                AND    cct.billed_amount IS NOT NULL),
               SYSDATE) AS oldest_avail_posted_date
    FROM   (
        SELECT DISTINCT cp.card_program_id,
               cp.card_program_name,
               icc.masked_cc_number AS card_number,
               card.card_id,
               'displayed_value' AS displayed_value,
               trxn.payment_due_from_code,
               LV.MEANING AS payment_due_from
        FROM   ap_card_programs_all cp,
               ap_cards_all card,
               ap_credit_card_trxns_all trxn,
               FND_LOOKUP_VALUES LV,
               iby_creditcard icc,
               params p
        WHERE  card.employee_id = (SELECT fu.employee_id
                                   FROM   fnd_user fu
                                   WHERE  fu.user_name = UPPER(TRIM('${EBS_USER}')))
        AND    card.org_id = p.org_id
        AND    cp.org_id = p.org_id
        AND    trxn.org_id = p.org_id
        AND    card.card_program_id = cp.card_program_id
        AND    (CASE WHEN AP_WEB_CUST_DFLEX_PKG.CustomCardInactiveBehaviour = '1'
                     THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) ELSE TRUNC(card.creation_date) END)
               BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(card.creation_date, SYSDATE))
               AND     TRUNC(NVL(card.inactive_date, SYSDATE))
        AND    cp.card_type_lookup_code = 'TRAVEL'
        AND    trxn.card_program_id = card.card_program_id
        AND    trxn.card_id = card.card_id
        AND    trxn.validate_code = 'Y'
        AND    trxn.payment_flag <> 'Y'
        AND    trxn.billed_amount IS NOT NULL
        AND    (trxn.report_header_id IS NULL OR trxn.report_header_id = p.report_header_id)
        AND    LV.lookup_type = 'PAYMENT_DUE_FROM'
        AND    LV.lookup_code = trxn.payment_due_from_code
        AND    card.card_reference_id = icc.instrid
        AND    TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(LV.start_date_active, SYSDATE))
                                  AND TRUNC(NVL(LV.end_date_active, SYSDATE))
        AND    LV.language = p.language_code
        AND    LV.view_application_id = 200
        AND    LV.security_group_id = p.security_group_id
    ) eligible_card
    UNION
    SELECT cp.card_program_id,
           cp.card_program_name,
           icc.masked_cc_number AS card_number,
           card.card_id,
           'displayed_value' AS displayed_value,
           cp.payment_due_from_code,
           LV.MEANING AS payment_due_from,
           SYSDATE AS oldest_avail_posted_date
    FROM   ap_card_programs_all cp,
           ap_cards_all card,
           FND_LOOKUP_VALUES LV,
           iby_creditcard icc,
           params p
    WHERE  card.employee_id = (SELECT fu.employee_id
                               FROM   fnd_user fu
                               WHERE  fu.user_name = UPPER(TRIM('${EBS_USER}')))
    AND    card.org_id = p.org_id
    AND    cp.org_id = p.org_id
    AND    card.card_program_id = cp.card_program_id
    AND    cp.card_type_lookup_code = 'TRAVEL'
    AND    LV.lookup_type = 'PAYMENT_DUE_FROM'
    AND    LV.lookup_code = cp.payment_due_from_code
    AND    card.card_reference_id = icc.instrid
    AND    TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(LV.start_date_active, SYSDATE))
                              AND TRUNC(NVL(LV.end_date_active, SYSDATE))
    AND    LV.language = p.language_code
    AND    LV.view_application_id = 200
    AND    LV.security_group_id = p.security_group_id
    AND    TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(NVL(card.creation_date, SYSDATE))
                              AND TRUNC(NVL(card.inactive_date, SYSDATE))
    AND    NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 'Y'
               FROM   ap_credit_card_trxns_all trxn
               WHERE  trxn.org_id = p.org_id
               AND    trxn.card_program_id = card.card_program_id
               AND    trxn.card_id = card.card_id
               AND    trxn.validate_code = 'Y'
               AND    trxn.payment_flag <> 'Y'
               AND    trxn.billed_amount IS NOT NULL
               AND    (trxn.report_header_id IS NULL OR trxn.report_header_id = p.report_header_id)
           )
) QRSLT
-- Binary NLS sort keeps card mask ordering independent of the DB session language.
ORDER BY oldest_avail_posted_date, NLSSORT(card_program_name, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY'), NLSSORT(card_number, 'NLS_SORT=BINARY')
